reason: Nobody in our kindergarten Telegram group has mentioned Kiddo, so I would download the free version and maybe try the 14 days, but I would not pay until other mothers say their child really learned letters with it. 25,000 a month is not nothing for us when the free part already has letters and numbers.
objection: Will my child actually learn, or will she just tap the mascot and play? I can't tell from an ad, and I don't trust a report the app writes about itself.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three mothers from our group or the kindergarten teacher saying their child learned to read the letters with it before school.
